rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone or something free from burdens, worries, or obligations.

example.english: Since moving out to live on my own, I feel unencumbered every day.
example.traditional: 自從搬出嚟自己住，我每日都覺得冇負擔。
example.jyutping: zi6 cung4 bun1 ceot1 lai4 zi6 gei2 zyu6 ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 gok3 dak1 mou5 fu6 daam1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on being free from worries, cares, or personal attachments rather than practical duties.

example.english: Now that my children are grown, I’m unencumbered and can travel wherever I want.
example.traditional: 仔女都大個，我而家無牽無掛，想去邊度旅行都得。
example.jyutping: zai2 neoi2 dou1 daai6 go3 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 mou4 hin1 mou4 gwaa3 soeng2 heoi3 bin1 dou6 leoi5 hang4 dou1 dak1

rows.note: Use this when the unencumbered aspect specifically means not having to take responsibility for something.

example.english: The boss made this decision, so we are unencumbered by having to take responsibility.
example.traditional: 呢個決定係老闆落嘅，我哋唔使負責任。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 hai6 lou5 baan2 lok6 ge3 ngo5 dei6 m4 sai2 fu6 zaak3 jam6
